title: SWF: FileAttributes tag (tag 69) encoding
description: Test that exported SWF contains FileAttributes (tag 69) as the first tag. Verify: (1) tag 69 appears before any other tags, (2) flags byte has HasMetadata=0, ActionScript3=0, UseDirectBlit=0, UseGPU=0 for a standard Flash 8 SWF, (3) FileAttributes (tag 69) is always 4 bytes body, (4) the tag is present for all exported SWFs regardless of content.
